verdict.line: You lose the lane and any pre-6 all-in, but the 54.9% win rate over 787 games comes from the mid-game once Trinity Force and Ravenous Hydra complete.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) pokes from 450 range on a 3.5s cooldown, well past your Q (Precision Protocol)'s 325 range, so he controls every neutral exchange before you can proc your own trade tool. His W (Path Maker) charge-into-knockback-stun then gives him the all-in initiative for the whole laning phase, which is exactly why the data shows K'Sante holding both lane advantage and solo-kill advantage. Camille's identity kit only flips the fight once Trinity Force and Ravenous Hydra are online — this matchup is won mid-game, not in lane.

theirWindow.when: He has 2 Q stacks and W ready
theirWindow.what: Two stacks of Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls you in, and he'll chain that into W (Path Maker)'s knockback-stun for a full lockdown. Back out of Q range before he hits 2 stacks, or if he's already charging W, land E (Hookshot)'s knockup on him mid-charge — hard CC cancels a charging dash before it fires.

yourWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without W he has no stun, only Q (Ntofo Strikes)'s slow to play around. Walk him down, land Q (Precision Protocol) on your first hit, and follow with E (Hookshot) off a nearby wall for the knockup to force a trade you start.

start.why: The highest-picked start (70.7% pick, 55.8% win rate over 627 games) gives you sustain to answer his Q poke instead of the raw HP of Doran's Shield.

boots.why: Flat physical damage reduction cuts down his autos and Q (Ntofo Strikes) chip damage during the poke-heavy laning phase (56.2% win rate, 66.6% pick).

core.why: This is your mid-game power spike — the point where the matchup flips from his favour to yours.
Sustain and AoE damage for skirmishes once you're forcing fights instead of surviving them.
Highest win rate completion of the three paths (63.9% over 155 games) — the bleed-through healing outlasts his burst once All Out drops.

situational.when: you're ahead and want the extra ability haste to loop R (Hextech Ultimatum) and Q (Precision Protocol) faster
his All Out burst is threatening to one-shot you through Death's Dance
their team stacks hard CC beyond K'Sante's own W stun

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained-trade healing directly answers a poke-first opponent — this is the defensive shape the matchup demands, and it's the highest-picked page (27.8% pick, 59.4% win rate).

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (49.9% pick, 57.1% win rate). Ignite punishes the healing K'Sante gets from All Out when he commits his all-in at level 6, and Flash covers you when you don't have a wall nearby for E (Hookshot) to answer his W engage.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: At 2 stacks, Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Don't extend a trade once he's near 2 stacks — disengage before he can chain it into W.

playing.title: Interrupt his W charge
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) has a charge-up before the dash fires. Landing E (Hookshot)'s knockup on him during that charge cancels the dash and the stun outright.

playing.title: Refuse Q-range trades
playing.detail: His Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits from 450 range, yours from 325. Don't stand in his line — make him walk in before you commit your own Q (Precision Protocol).

playing.title: Play passive levels 3-5
playing.detail: This is his W all-in window and you have no R yet. Hold W (Tactical Sweep) for its outer-half slow and self-heal to answer his engage instead of initiating.

playing.title: Use walls to flank
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) has 800 range off a wall. Once he's spent Q stacks or W, reposition through a tri-bush or river wall to hit him from an angle he can't Footwork away from.

playing.title: Start initiating at Trinity Force
playing.detail: Around levels 9-11 once Trinity Force completes, stop playing around his cooldowns and start forcing trades — this is where the matchup's win rate flips.

playing.title: Save R for his All Out
playing.detail: R (Hextech Ultimatum) anchors him to you and adds bonus magic damage on your autos. Use it the moment he pops All Out so Footwork (E) can't get him out of the fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoners, and every win rate above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch, including the 787-game Camille vs K'Sante sample. The tell timings, cooldown interactions, and trade-pattern reasoning are our own coaching read, not measured data.
